summary: Frontend mobile web verification completed at 390x844. Home, six recordings, playback exclusivity, Surprise Me, Sleep Mode timers/close, birthday unlock/close usability, note save, and responsive layout were exercised.
action_items: Optional: unmount BirthdayModal when hidden or add a testID/state attribute if automated visibility checks need to distinguish hidden opacity from visible UI.
critical_code_review_comments: BirthdayModal stays mounted after close with opacity 0 and pointerEvents none; this is functionally usable and did not block note editing, but DOM visibility assertions still see the hidden layer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows passed; 1 semantic hidden-layer observation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo web loaded from the configured public preview URL. Sleep Mode absolute overlay opened/closed correctly. Three coffee taps revealed the birthday message; closing it left the home screen usable and note editing/saving worked. The hidden birthday Animated.View remains mounted with opacity 0/pointerEvents none by design.
rca_of_issue: The birthday close handler sets birthdayVisible false, but BirthdayModal is always rendered. Its Animated.View remains in the tree with opacity 0 and pointerEvents none, so locator is_visible can report it as visible even though it is not visually displayed or interactive.
